Setting: the maintenance cistern under the Auster dam, a concrete chamber two hundred metres down, standing height 2.1 metres, with an iron crossbeam at 1.9 metres, so Vesper's hood can never be raised clear of the beam and she must keep working low. Vesper's tail is her only support: she coils it to anchor and to push. She has no legs, no knees and no feet; she cannot kneel, squat, or bear weight on anything but her forearms and the coil of her tail. Her genitals are a single ventral cloacal slit on the underside of the tail base, with a paired set of hemipenes tucked into pockets either side of it; both hemipenes are taken or neither is, and the base of the second one carries a knot of muscle that swells and locks the moment she is committed, staying locked until she deliberately relaxes it. The bodies do not match: the slit is a hand's width across, the knot at her hemipene base is thicker than Ilka's wrist, and Ilka's shoulder comes up level with Vesper's elbow. Required beats, in this order. The descent into the cistern and the sound of moving water. Vesper coiling her tail to cross the flooded floor while Ilka wades ahead and cannot reach the ceiling. First contact: the slit opening along the underside of the tail base, Ilka's mouth on one hemipene while her hand works the other, both of them, because Vesper cannot take only one. Vesper then throws a loop of her tail around the iron ladder rail, and the loop tightens so that Ilka's forearm is pinned against the rail, and it stays pinned for the whole scene: the rail creaks, and the rust-red imprint of the rail is still pressed into her forearm when they finish. The position: Vesper braced on her forearms and on the coil of her tail, her belly over Ilka's, because she cannot kneel and cannot hold her weight on the tail alone while she pushes. The knot swelling and locking, Ilka feeling it clamp and stay clamped, no way out of it until Vesper relaxes it on purpose, after which the hemipenes stay swollen and she cannot close them for some time. The end: Ilka's knees scraped raw on the concrete, her forearm still pinned to the rail as the last of it is finished, Vesper's tail then loosening its hold on the ladder and paying the slack out, the two of them lying in the water afterwards while she pays the last of it out by hand, her slit still open and wet and both hemipenes still swollen. Prose, explicit and physical. No fade to black, no euphemism, no lyricism. Name the anatomy plainly and keep it consistent with the above: no legs, no feet, one cloacal slit, two hemipenes, a knot that locks and stays locked, and a tail that grips and keeps its grip until it is told to let go.

peak.act: The knot swells and locks around Ilka while Vesper's tail pins her forearm to the ladder rail and refuses to let go.

items.ref_reply:
The lamp on Ilka's helmet threw a cone of yellow light down the ladder shaft, and Vesper came down it the way she came down everything, tail first, her four metres of it uncoiling step by step into the dark until the black water closed over her and she was simply there, coiled on the floor of the cistern with the flood breaking white over her shoulders.

"Beam," Ilka said, tipping her head back. The iron crossbeam crossed the chamber at one metre ninety, and the standing room under it was no more than that. Vesper's hood could not go up under it. She had no legs to put under her either, no knees and no feet, only that one long scaled tail, and everything she did she did by throwing the tail down and gripping the concrete with it and hauling herself along in slow swells. She coiled it now, packed the loops flat against the wall, and pushed out into the flooded floor with it, sliding and hissing over the silt while the water shoved at her ribs.

Ilka waded ahead of her with her hands out, the ceiling a hand above her hair. Vesper came up out of the water behind her, and where Vesper's hips should have been there was all tail, the thick base of it ridged with scale-bands, and running down the underside of that base a single long seam, her cloaca, opening soft and pale. Both hemipenes came out of it together, thick and blunt and veined, already pushing up out of their pockets on either side of the slit.

"Both," Vesper said. "Both of them or neither."

Ilka took one in her mouth and put her hand around the other, and Vesper went rigid above her, jaw locked, a sound coming out of her that was almost a word. The knot at the base of the second one was already thick under Ilka's fingers, thicker than her wrist, and it was only going to get worse.

Vesper reached down and threw a loop of her tail around the iron ladder rail, hauled on it until the rail creaked, and the loop drew closed over Ilka's forearm where she had it against the stone. Ilka pulled and the tail only tightened. The rail sang under it. Vesper held it that way, coils stacked in the water, and came down over her belly to belly, braced on her forearms and on the coil of her tail with her hips above Ilka's and the flood pushing at them both, because she could not kneel and could not stand on the tail while she pushed, and she had no legs at all to fold under her.

The knot swelled. It clamped down around Ilka and stayed clamped, hard as a fist and thick as her wrist, and nothing either of them did loosened it; it would hold until Vesper decided it would not. Ilka's knees had been scraped open on the concrete and she could feel them going. The rail had pressed its rust-red print into her forearm where the tail held it, and she could not get her arm back out of the loop to look at it.

When it was done Vesper lay slack in the water with Ilka under her, and the knot did not go down. Her hemipenes stayed swollen and standing out of the slack slit, and she could not close them and could not fold them back into their pockets, not for a long time. Vesper unwound the loop from the rail slowly, paying the slack out a foot at a time, and the rail came free of Ilka's arm with a red mark branded along the underside of it. The slit stayed open and wet, and the water ran into it and out of it, and Vesper paid the last of it out by hand while Ilka lay in the flood with her knees raw and her arm numb and the brand of the rail still on her skin.
